serverInfo.name: siftrcode
serverInfo.description: AST-powered codebase skeletonizer and context pruner for AI coding agents. Slashes agent token waste by up to 90%.

tools.name: siftr_skeleton
tools.description: Returns the pruned AST interface skeleton of source code. Strips function bodies and internal loops while preserving 100% of exported types, signatures, classes, and docstrings. Cuts token usage by 80-95%.

language.description: Source language: typescript, python, go, or rust

filename.description: Optional filename (e.g. index.ts, app.py, main.go, lib.rs)

tools.name: siftr_audit
tools.description: Audits source code or repository for token bloat, dead weight, and context waste. Returns potential token and cost savings.

tools.name: siftr_pack
tools.description: Prepares an AST-compressed context pack for AI coding agents.
